articles.title: Ex-Celsius CEO Mashinsky gets U.S. CFTC ban in final resolution with regulator
articles.snippet: Alexander Mashinsky, the founder of failed crypto lender Celsius, had earlier been imprisoned for fraud and is now formally banned from CFTC registration.

articles.title: CFTC Hits Celsius Crypto Fraudster Alex Mashinsky With Permanent Trading Ban
articles.snippet: The settlement ensures that convicted Celsius founder Alex Mashinsky is unable to trade in CFTC markets or register with the regulator.
